mentions.note: Strong performance; travel resilience holding despite geopolitical headwinds.
Brand-name monopoly in short-term rentals; strong global presence; long-term value for app-based platform.
Travel & leisure challenged by gas prices and geopolitical tensions but Wells Fargo sees inflection; CEO Brian Chesky 'real'; at right price level to buy.

Q2 beat accelerating growth; AI writing 60% of code, cutting support costs 16% YoY, enabling natural-language trip planning. Hotel nights growing 3x faster than short-term rentals. But up 44% in 6 months, 34x forward earnings at $180 too rich to chase. Buy a little, wait for pullback.
